thread:
maria: quick Q about the prompt/prefix caching contract — i'm reviewing the API changes in the PR and want to make sure we agree on headers + hit semantics for backward compatibility. TL;DR: new headers we plan to add: `X-Cache-Key`, `X-Cache-Hit`, and `Cache-Control` hints. how should endpoints behave when the client doesn't send `Cache-Control`?
aj: my take — server should assume cacheable by default unless `Cache-Control: no-store` or `no-cache` is present. we should expose `X-Cache-Status: miss|hit|stale` (string) rather than boolean to allow `stale` for soft-expiry.
maria: ok. want to avoid breaking older clients that expect no headers — so default responses must be unchanged except for adding headers. are we comfortable adding `X-Cache-Key` (deterministic key) to responses? helps debugging but might leak prompt fragments.
kevin: privacy angle — we can't include raw prompt in header. `X-Cache-Key` should be a salted hash (sha256 prefix) + version tag, e.g. `v2:abcd1234`. that gives us a stable debugging surface without exposing text.
sasha: +1 to hashed key. also we need a clear contract for `X-Cache-Hit` vs `X-Cache-Status`. i'd prefer `X-Cache-Hit: 1|0` for simple consumers and `X-Cache-Status` for richer tools. fallback: if `X-Cache-Hit` present, it must match `X-Cache-Status` semantics.
maria: sounds good. proposal: add both headers. `X-Cache-Hit: 1` and `X-Cache-Status: hit`. on miss: `X-Cache-Hit: 0` and `X-Cache-Status: miss`. on soft-expire: `X-Cache-Hit: 1` and `X-Cache-Status: stale`? that might be confusing.
aj: for stale serving (we might return stale while refreshing), i'd set `X-Cache-Hit: 1` and `X-Cache-Status: stale-while-revalidate`. keeps boolean consumer semantics (served from cache) and richer status available.
kevin: we should document TTL semantics in the API doc: `Cache-Control: max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30` for example. server should accept client `Cache-Control` to opt-out or request fresh. if client requests `max-age=0` treat as must-revalidate.
maria: sample response snippet to include in docs?

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=30
X-Cache-Key: v2:7f4a1c9b
X-Cache-Hit: 1
X-Cache-Status: stale-while-revalidate
Content-Type: application/json

{ "id": "resp_123", "output": "..." }
```

kevin: perfect. question about invalidation: when a model rollout occurs (v2->v3), do we change the key prefix (we should) and how do we signal that to Dedicated/Private deployments?
sasha: change prefix on model version bump + include header `X-Cache-Model-Version: v3`. Dedicated/private nodes should be able to expose an admin endpoint to purge keys by prefix. we already have that in infra but need an API for the control plane to trigger it on rollout.
aj: note for backwards compatibility: if `X-Cache-Key` absent (old servers), clients should treat response as non-cacheable — i.e., don't try to key local caches. but server-side behavior unchanged.
maria: action items: (1) aj to update PR to emit both headers and add salted key hashing; (2) kevin to add docs for TTL and example `Cache-Control`; (3) sasha to list infra endpoints for purge and add a small control-plane hook for rollouts. i'll ping reviewers.
sasha: added infra todo: `POST /admin/cache/purge` with body `{ "prefix": "v2:" }` and audit log.

aj: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-api/pull/432 (draft). please comment.
maria: quick ask — can someone do a short compat test matrix (hosted + dedicated + private) to ensure header additions don't break proxies (nginx, envoy) and don't trigger caching on clients that don't expect it?
kevin: i'll run a matrix tomorrow — nginx/1.22, envoy 1.26, and cloudfront. will report.
aj: small code snippet for hashing we plan to include in SDKs: `key = f\"v{ver}:{sha256(salt + prompt)[:8]}\"` — recommend 8 hex chars is enough for ops and short header size.
maria: perfect. final note: include migration note in changelog: header additions are additive and opt-in for clients reading them. if anybody on the thread wants to be a reviewer ping me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for `feature/prompt-cache-headers` — staging in 5m.
maria: thanks — i'll validate logs on staging once it's up.
sasha: also adding a test that asserts `X-Cache-Key` is hashed and length < 32 chars.
maria: closing — will follow up with doc links once kevin/aj PRs land.
